info.name: StockAccount API
info.description: StockAccountApp API (CONTRACT v1.1). Folders run in order; tokens and ids are captured into collection variables. The refresh token is an httpOnly cookie kept by the cookie jar. Generated by build-collection.mjs.

exec: // Logs in as admin when accessToken is empty or about to expire. The refresh token stays in Postman's cookie jar (httpOnly sa_refresh).
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: pm.environment.get('adminEmail'), password: pm.environment.get('adminPassword') }) }
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error('auto-login failed', err || res.code); return; }

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login / cookie refresh rotation / logout. Tokens for the three roles are captured here.

exec: pm.test('sa_refresh cookie set (httpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/)', () => { const sc = pm.response.headers.all().filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase()==='set-cookie').map(h=>h.value).join('\n'); pm.expect(sc).to.include('sa_refresh='); pm.expect(sc.toLowerCase()).to.include('httponly'); pm.expect(sc.toLowerCase()).to.include('samesite=strict'); pm.expect(sc.toLowerCase()).to.include('path=/'); });
pm.test('new access token, no refresh token in body', () => { pm.expect(b.accessToken).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('refreshToken'); });

item.name: Invoices
item.description: Draft CRUD, approve (numbering, ledgers), INSUFFICIENT_STOCK, type mismatch, concurrency, cancel (admin).

exec: pm.test('Draft, ALS, totals 100/20/120, no number', () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('Draft'); pm.expect(b.series).to.eql('ALS'); pm.expect(b.subTotal).to.eql(100); pm.expect(b.vatTotal).to.eql(20); pm.expect(b.grandTotal).to.eql(120); pm.expect(b.number).to.be.null; pm.expect(b.documentNo).to.be.null; });

item.name: Approve purchase → ALS number, stock In
Stock trans of cancelled sale (Out + reversal In)

exec: pm.test('2 rows: Out and reversal In', () => { pm.expect(it).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(it.filter(r => r.isReversal).map(r => r.direction)).to.eql(['In']); pm.expect(it.filter(r => !r.isReversal).map(r => r.direction)).to.eql(['Out']); });

item.name: Act trans of cancelled sale (Debit + reversal Credit)
Portal
item.description: Portal user (ahmet) sees only his own account, transactions and non-draft invoices.

exec: pm.test('no drafts, own account only', () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(i => { pm.expect(i.status).not.to.eql('Draft'); pm.expect(i.currentAccountCode).to.eql('C001'); }));

pm.test('openapi doc with bearer scheme', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.paths).to.have.property('/api/invoices/{id}/approve'); pm.expect(JSON.stringify(b.components.securitySchemes).toLowerCase()).to.include('bearer'); });

item.name: Scenario – Ahmet Elma
item.description: Reference scenario (CONTRACT §3.2): Ahmet buys 2 kg Elma × 50 @1% → 101.00; ledgers and balances verified, then cancelled (balances restored).

exec: pm.test('ELMA exists, Kg, VAT 1', () => { pm.expect(s).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(s.unit).to.eql('Kg'); pm.expect(s.vatRate).to.eql(1); pm.expect(s.balance).to.be.at.least(2); });

pm.test('Draft 100 / 1 / 101, number null', () => { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('Draft'); pm.expect(b.subTotal).to.eql(100); pm.expect(b.vatTotal).to.eql(1); pm.expect(b.grandTotal).to.eql(101); pm.expect(b.number).to.be.null; });

pm.test('exactly one Out 2.000 row for ELMA', () => { pm.expect(it).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(it[0].stockCode).to.eql('ELMA'); pm.expect(it[0].direction).to.eql('Out'); pm.expect(it[0].quantity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(it[0].isReversal).to.be.false; pm.expect(it[0].documentNo).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('ahmetDocNo')); });

pm.test('exactly one Debit 101.00 row for C001', () => { pm.expect(it).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(it[0].currentAccountCode).to.eql('C001'); pm.expect(it[0].direction).to.eql('Debit'); pm.expect(it[0].amount).to.eql(101); });

item.name: 10. Portal: Ahmet sees the balance and invoice

exec: pm.test('Out + reversal In', () => { const it = pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(it).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(it.some(r => r.isReversal && r.direction === 'In')).to.be.true; });
